_doc: Task titles written beside a mention of the same task, and what the source reads after the pill absorbs them. Read by tests/web/markdown/task-title-absorb.test.ts (web), tests/web/board-markdown.test.ts (Board frame) and ios-native/WalnutTests/TaskTitleAbsorbTests.swift (phone). Ids resolve exactly or by a unique first segment.

tasks.cd9b029e-1d2c-5e3f-8a4b-6c7d8e9f0a1b: Keep the Home layout on disk · Org Lock
